title: Mold Remediation Deposit, Payment Terms and Late Fee Figures
content:
The accounts receivable figures for Mold Remediation jobs, tier by tier:

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-pay deposit (USD) | 150.00 | 400.00 | 750.00 | 1500.00 | 900.00 | 700.00 |
| Payment terms, self-pay (calendar days after invoice date) | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Payment terms, insurance-funded (calendar days after invoice date) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Late fee per monthly fee period (percent of past-due balance) | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% |
| Late fee minimum per monthly fee period (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Late fee grace days (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Claim-pending late fee suspension (calendar days from invoice date) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Credit card surcharge (percent of payment) | 2.95% | 2.95% | 2.95% | 2.95% | 2.95% | 2.95% |
| Refund processing time (business days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## What each figure is

1. **Self-pay deposit**: the deposit a self-pay customer pays before containment is set.
2. **Payment terms**: the days after the final invoice date by which a self-pay balance (15) or an insurance-funded balance (45) is due, in calendar days.
3. **Late fee**: the late fee on the past-due balance per monthly fee period, as a percentage, with the late fee minimum per monthly fee period in dollars.
4. **Grace days**: the calendar days after the due date before the first late fee may post.
5. **Claim-pending suspension**: the calendar days after the final invoice date during which late fees are suspended on an insurance-funded job whose claim file is still awaiting carrier payment.
6. **Credit card surcharge**: the surcharge on payments made by credit card, never on debit card, ACH or check payments.
7. **Refund processing**: the business days, Monday to Friday excluding company holidays, to issue an overpayment refund after it is approved.

Only the self-pay deposit differs between tiers, from 150.00 on Spot Mold Remediation to 1500.00 on Extensive Mold Remediation. Every other figure in the table is the same on all six tiers.

Hypothetical check: a credit card payment of 640.00 carries a surcharge of 2.95 percent of 640.00, which is 18.88.
